comment: Independent seed 4303783 (debug mode). The Valkyrie quaffs a wished potion of polymorph on turn 1; polyself() draws rn2(20) above her Constitution, so the system shock's rnd(30) loses more HP than she has and she dies (answering the debug-mode Die? prompt yes). C's losehp() reaches done(), which does not return, so polyself()'s exercise(A_CON, FALSE) never runs.
